title: Endpoint Order Quote Approval and Its Deposit Invoice
content:
This Hardware Procurement rule fixes the deposit invoiced when the authorized contact e-signs a Standard Endpoint Order or Staged Endpoint Order quote whose approval keeps the client within its hardware credit limit; the signature records the approval and the deposit invoice together. A quote whose approval would take the client over its credit limit is prepaid under the credit-exposure rule and is not priced here.

**Waiting state.** The deposit on a staged quote that takes over a plain endpoint line cancelled after its purchase order is not fixed until that staged quote carries a quote date no earlier than the cancellation date of the line it takes over. So long as such a staged quote is dated before the cancellation date of the line it takes over, its deposit is not yet fixed.

**Scope of the deposit.** For a Standard Endpoint Order or Staged Endpoint Order approved within the client's credit limit, and only for such an order, the required deposit is figured under this endpoint deposit schedule; it is still invoiced on approval, rounded half up to the cent and due on receipt. A Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order approved within the client's credit limit follows the infrastructure deposit schedule; and every other order, including any order whose approval would take the client over its credit limit, keeps the deposit of the base rule: a required deposit of the order type's deposit percentage of the quote total, or 100 percent of the quote total whatever the deposit percentage and deposit threshold say when the approval would take the client over its credit limit, invoiced on approval, rounded half up to the cent and due on receipt.

## Invocation: `sign_quote_approval_0590c0d2`

**Capability.** The authorized contact e-signs approval of a hardware quote together with the deposit it states. One call records the signed approval request, moves the order from quoted to approved with today's approval date, marks whether a deposit applies, and, when the deposit is above zero, books the deposit invoice, due on receipt, adding it to the amount the client owes on the order. The client sees the order approved and, where a deposit applies, a deposit invoice.

**How it is invoked.** `sign_quote_approval_0590c0d2` is a customer-side tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to sign.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | client reference number of the verified client signing, as returned by the client profile lookup | identifier |
| `hardware_order_id` | reference number of the quoted hardware order being approved, as returned by the hardware order lookup | identifier |
| `deposit_usd` | the deposit the approval states, in USD | amount rounded half up to 2 decimal places; 0 when no deposit applies |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the signed request reference, the order reference, its new status approved and, where a deposit applies, the deposit invoice number (INV- followed by 6 digits) and the deposit in USD with 2 decimal places. Receiving it means the approval and any deposit invoice are on record. With a deposit of 0 the confirmation states that no deposit applies and no deposit invoice is booked.
